name: quickfix
description: One saved Orchflows workflow, fix, for a small bounded change to an existing project: Work with tests on a branch, one independent cross-vendor Review, one repair pass, then the project's delivery mode.

interface.shortDescription: Bounded fix: Work with tests, cross-vendor Review, one repair, then delivery.
interface.longDescription: A single named workflow, quickfix:fix, for small bounded changes to an existing project. One Work implements the change with tests on a branch in the project's own delivery mode; one independent Review by a fresh agent from a different vendor audits that branch; one repair pass steers the same Work agent with the findings; the project's delivery mode lands it. Runs only when the captain names it.
interface.defaultPrompt: Run quickfix:fix only when I name it, for a small bounded change to an existing project.
